ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Which of these insects cause Malaria?
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, from left to right there are three illustrations of insect heads/bodies, with the bottoms labeled A, E, and C respectively. The insect labeled E in the middle has a slender body, has very long and thin mouthparts/body parts and slender appendages, and its appearance conforms to the characteristics of a mosquito. The insects on the left and right do not look like mosquitoes; the one on the right looks more like a fly-type insect. Reasoning: The question asks “Which insect causes Malaria?”. Scientific common sense is that malaria is transmitted by mosquitoes, especially female Anopheles mosquitoes. Therefore the insect that causes/transmits malaria is the mosquito; if it needs to correspond to an option in the figure, then it is the middle E.
